errors.text_span: 其中横坐标表示“音频长/秒”，纵坐标表示“文本文本/字数”。
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly treats two separate bar charts as a single chart. It assigns the x-axis label from the left chart ("音频长/秒") as the overall x-axis and a misinterpretation of the right chart's x-axis label ("文本长度/字符") as the overall y-axis ("文本文本/字数"). In reality, both charts have their own x- and y-axes.

errors.text_span: 横坐标轴包含数据集的音频长/秒，标签从 0-5 到 140-160
errors.evidence: This description incorrectly merges the x-axes of the two separate charts. It takes the label from the left chart ("音频长/秒"), the starting category from the left chart ("0-5"), and the ending category from the right chart ("140-160").

errors.text_span: 纵坐标轴包含数据集的文本文本/字数，标签从 0 到 30000，刻度是线性的，0 到 30000 的单位是文本文本/字数，并且刻度以 1000 个文本文本/字数的间隔显示。
errors.evidence: This description of the y-axis is entirely incorrect. The y-axis labels are "对应音频个数" (left chart) and "对应文本个数" (right chart), not "文本文本/字数". The range 0-30000 only applies to the right chart (the left is 0-35000). The tick interval is 5000, not 1000.

The description completely omits the actual y-axis labels for both charts, which are "对应音频个数" (Number of corresponding audios) for the left chart and "对应文本个数" (Number of corresponding texts) for the right chart.

errors.text_span: 最长的柱状图的数值为 35000
errors.evidence: The value of the longest bar in the first chart is explicitly labeled as 33964. The description incorrectly states the maximum value of the y-axis scale, 35000.

errors.text_span: 最短的柱状图的数值为 106
errors.evidence: In the first chart, the shortest bar corresponds to the '31-35' category, with a value of 80. The value 106 corresponds to the '35-40' category.
The description incorrectly calls the x-axis categories a "日期范围" (date range). The x-axis of the left chart represents audio duration in seconds.

errors.text_span: 最短的柱状图的数值为 188
errors.evidence: In the second chart, the shortest bar corresponds to the '121-140' category, with a value of 154. The value 188 corresponds to the '140-160' category.

errors.text_span: 图例表明第一个柱状图代表“音频长/秒”和第二个柱状图代表“文本文本/字数”。
errors.evidence: The figure does not contain a legend. The description hallucinates the presence of a legend and what it shows.
